const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: `set -o pipefail
printf '%s\\n' '===top==='
git rev-parse --show-toplevel
printf '%s\\n' '===instruction files up tree==='
for f in AGENTS.override.md AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md; do
  p="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/$f"; [ -f "$p" ] && { echo "--- $p"; sed -n '1,260p' "$p"; }
done
printf '%s\\n' '===gotchas candidates==='
find "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" -maxdepth 3 \\( -name 'GOTCHAS.md' -o -name 'AGENTS.md' -o -name 'AGENTS.override.md' \\) -print | sort
printf '%s\\n' '===source diff==='
git diff --find-renames --find-copies --unified=80 d21f6afffa914b4fd4cffd3daa350cd2600d0ccd -- scripts/check-mcp-app-bundle.mjs src/mcp-apps/_shared/host.tsx src/mcp-apps/_shared/openai-compat.ts`,
  workdir: "/Users/burakemre/Code/lobu/.claude/worktrees/mcp-app-v8/packages/owletto",
  yield_time_ms: 10000,

});
text(r.output);
